Strategy: Do not burn a barely-double bin. A bin that just fits a double item loses it if filled now, while a looser bin keeps it and smaller bins never had it. Score by leftover, penalizing a bin that fits a double item whose leftover would not, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a smaller or looser bin. It may help by saving double-size capacity, but may fail by wasting loose bins when double items never arrive.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - (item if r >= item * 2 and r - item < item * 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Barely-double penalty: penalize bins in [2*item, 3*item) whose leftover drops below 2*item.
